description: Retrieves a specific Calendly organization invitation using its UUID and the parent organization's UUID.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for retrieving a specific Calendly organization invitation.

org_uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Calendly organization to which the invitation belongs.
org_uuid.title: Org Uuid

uuid.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the specific organization invitation to retrieve.
uuid.title: Uuid

inputSchema.title: GetOrganizationInvitationRequest

name: get_organization_invitation

GetOrganizationInvitationResponse.description: Contains the detailed information of the retrieved Calendly organization invitation.

resource.description: Wrapper object containing the organization invitation resource data
resource.title: Resource

GetOrganizationInvitationResponse.title: GetOrganizationInvitationResponse

created_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation was created (ISO 8601 format)
created_at.title: Created At

email.description: Email address of the person invited to join the organization
email.title: Email

last_sent_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation email was last sent to the invitee (ISO 8601 format)
last_sent_at.title: Last Sent At

organization.description: Reference (URI) to the organization that the invitation belongs to
organization.title: Organization

status.description: Status of the organization invitation. Possible values: 'pending', 'accepted', 'declined'
status.title: Status

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the invitation was last updated (ISO 8601 format)
updated_at.title: Updated At

uri.description: Canonical reference (unique identifier) for the organization invitation
uri.title: Uri

user.description: Reference (URI) to the user associated with the invitation after it has been accepted
user.title: User
